act_title: The National Capital Territory of Delhi Laws (Special Provisions) Second Act, 2011
title: Provisions of this Act not to apply in certain cases
text:
4. Provisions of this Act not to apply in certain cases.—During the period of operation of this Act,

no relief shall be available under the provisions of section 3 in respect of the following encroachment or
unauthorised development, namely:—

(a) encroachment on public land except in those cases which are covered under clauses [(a) and

(c)] of sub-section (1) of section 3;

(b) removal of slums and _Jhuggi-Jhompri dwellers,_ unauthorised colonies or part thereof,

village _abadi area (including urban villages) and their extensions in accordance with the relevant_
policies approved by the Central Government for clearance of land required for specific public
projects.
